summary: Custom notification attributes, part 4: job_template, unified_job_template, instance_group, created_by and labels in summary_fields; reference them with {{ }} and dotted notation, for example {{ job.summary_fields.inventory.name }}, or use {{ job_friendly_name }} {{ job.id }}.
questions: How do I write a custom notification message in controller?
How do I include who launched a job in a notification?
How do I reference the inventory name in a notification?

answer_card.title: Custom notification message syntax
answer_card.answer_md:
Use `{{ }}` with dotted notation on the `job` object:

```
{{ job_friendly_name }} {{ job.id }} ran on {{ job.execution_node }} in {{ job.elapsed }} seconds.
```

For nested fields: `{{ job.summary_fields.inventory.name }}`, `{{ job.summary_fields.created_by.username }}`, `{{ job.summary_fields.project.name }}`.
